prompt: The dimly lit captain's cabin of a pirate ship. A large wooden desk dominates the space, upon which a ship's logbook lies open next to a feather quill and an inkwell. A single gold doubloon gleams beside a bottle of rum. A skull-shaped candle holder provides flickering light. A heavy captain's chair is tucked under the desk. A large world map is pinned to the wall behind the desk. Leaning against the wall is a sharp cutlass and the ship's wheel, while a flintlock pistol rests on the desk. In a corner, a large treasure chest is partially open, and a coil of rope sits on the floor. A brass sextant and a compass are on a small shelf. A hammock is slung across one side of the room. A loyal parrot sits on its perch near a hanging lantern. A telescope rests on a windowsill looking out at the sea. This is a rugged pirate's domain, not a royal chamber, so there is no king's crown to be found. Modern conveniences are unheard of; there is no electric light or modern radio. Comforts are few, so you will not see a delicate teacup or a fluffy teddy bear, and a true pirate scoffs at safety, leaving no life vest in sight.
